categories.main_business_segments: Shaanxi Sirui Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. primarily operates in advanced copper alloy materials and products, medium and high voltage electrical contact materials and products, high-performance metal chromium powder, CT and DR tube components for medical imaging, optical module chip bases and housings, and liquid rocket engine thrust chamber inner walls. These segments serve industries such as rail transit, aerospace, power electronics, medical imaging, semiconductors, and clean energy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including vacuum induction melting, vacuum self-consuming arc melting, vacuum sintering, vacuum infiltration, 3D printing, atmospheric protection continuous casting, vacuum atomization, vacuum magnetic levitation melting, vacuum electroslag remelting, hot isostatic pressing, and precision machining. It also develops proprietary manufacturing processes for high-strength, high-conductivity copper alloys, copper-chromium and copper-tungsten contact materials, and advanced powder metallurgy techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global industry leaders such as GE Group, Wabtec Group, Siemens, Alstom, Schneider Electric, ABB, Eaton, China CRRC, and domestic and international medical imaging equipment manufacturers like United Imaging Healthcare and Varex Imaging. The company serves markets in rail transit, aerospace, power grid, medical imaging, semiconductors, and clean energy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, and has expanded internationally with manufacturing bases in Thailand and Singapore. Its sales cover domestic markets and international markets including Europe, the United States, RCEP member countries, and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shaanxi Sirui Advanced Materials operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, and manufacturing of advanced copper alloy materials and components that serve as critical inputs for downstream industries such as aerospace, rail transit, power equipment, medical imaging, and semiconductors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with strategic R&D investments in advanced copper alloys, vacuum contact materials, high-purity chromium powders, medical imaging components, and aerospace materials. It focuses on developing new materials like copper-chromium-niobium alloys, 3D printing technologies, and hot isostatic pressing. Collaborations with universities and research institutes, participation in national key projects, and digital transformation are key priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of advanced materials and precision components to industrial customers. The company operates a direct sales model, providing customized, non-standardized products tailored to client specifications across various high-tech industries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in multiple niche markets globally, holding top market shares in high-strength, high-conductivity copper alloys and medium-high voltage electrical contact materials in China. It competes with international giants like Siemens, ABB, and GE in various segments and is recognized as a national champion in several product categories.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenues of approximately RMB 1.33 billion, representing a 12.73% year-over-year increase, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 114.24 million, up 16.17%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue, profitability, and cash flow, with significant investments in capacity expansion and R&D. Total assets reached over RMB 2.13 billion, growing 24.39% from the prior year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shaanxi Sirui Advanced Materials differentiates itself through its advanced proprietary technologies, high-quality and high-performance copper alloy materials, and precision manufacturing capabilities. It offers customized solutions with strong R&D support, enabling import substitution in critical sectors like aerospace, power grid, and medical imaging. The company emphasizes sustainability with green manufacturing and products that support carbon reduction initiatives.
